name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.augmentM_val
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat)
  (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (p : List.{0} ν),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.val (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.augmentM N c U p))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.augment N U p)

source.code:
theorem augmentM_val (U : List (ν × ν)) (p : List ν) : (N.augmentM c U p).val = N.augment U p := by
  unfold augmentM augment
  simp only [bind_val, stepsM_val, pure_val]
  rw [filterM_val 1 _ (fun a => decide ((a.2, a.1) ∉ steps p)) (fun a => by
      simp [bind_val, stepsM_val, memM_val]),
    filterM_val 1 _ (fun e => decide (e ∈ N.arcs)) (fun e => by simp [memM_val])]

ν : Type
inst✝ : DecidableEq ν
N : Network ν
c : ν → ℕ
U : List (ν × ν)
p : List ν
⊢ (N.augmentM c U p).val = N.augment U p

ν : Type
inst✝ : DecidableEq ν
N : Network ν
c : ν → ℕ
U : List (ν × ν)
p : List ν
⊢ (do
        let A ←
          filterM 1
              (fun a => do
                let st ← stepsM p
                tick (1 + pc c (a.2, a.1))
                let m ← memM c st (a.2, a.1)
                Pure.pure !m)
              U
        let st ← stepsM p
        let B ← filterM 1 (fun e => memM c N.arcs e) st
        tick U.length
        Pure.pure (A ++ B)).val =
    List.filter (fun a => decide ((a.2, a.1) ∉ steps p)) U ++ List.filter (fun e => decide (e ∈ N.arcs)) (steps p)

    List.filter (fun a => decide ((a.2, a.1) ∉ steps p)) U ++ List.filter (fun e => decide (e ∈ N.arcs)) (steps p)
